20001.title: Reina Roja: Freedom Fighter
20001.text: The first piece of ice the Corp rezzes each turn costs 1[credit] more to rez.
20001.strippedText: The first piece of ice the Corp rezzes each turn costs 1 credit more to rez.
20001.flavor: "Analyzing the board won't help. Your mistake was thinking we're playing the same game."

20002.title: Demolition Run
20002.text: Run HQ or R&D. Access → 0[credit]: Trash the card you are accessing.
20002.strippedText: Run HQ or R&D. Access -> 0 credits: Trash the card you are accessing.
20002.flavor: You ever set something on fire just to watch it burn?

20003.title: Retrieval Run
20003.text: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, you may install 1 program from your heap, ignoring all costs.
20003.strippedText: Run Archives. If successful, instead of breaching Archives, you may install 1 program from your heap, ignoring all costs.

20004.title: Singularity
20004.text:
As an additional cost to play this event, spend [click].
Run a remote server. If successful, instead of breaching that server, trash all cards installed in the root of that server.
20004.strippedText: As an additional cost to play this event, spend click. Run a remote server. If successful, instead of breaching that server, trash all cards installed in the root of that server.

20005.title: Stimhack
20005.text: Place 9[credit] on this event, then run any server. During that run, hosted credits are considered to be in your credit pool. When that run ends, suffer 1 core damage. This damage cannot be prevented.
20005.strippedText: Place 9 credits on this event, then run any server. During that run, hosted credits are considered to be in your credit pool. When that run ends, suffer 1 core damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

20006.title: Cyberfeeder
20006.text: 1[recurring-credit] Use this credit to pay for using icebreakers or for installing virus programs.
20006.strippedText: 1 recurring credit Use this credit to pay for using icebreakers or for installing virus programs.
20006.flavor: I feel almost naked without it.

20007.title: Spinal Modem
20007.text: +1[mu], 2[recurring-credit] You can spend hosted credits to use icebreakers. Whenever there is a successful trace during a run, suffer 1 core damage. Limit 1 console per player.
20007.strippedText: +1 mu, 2 recurring credits You can spend hosted credits to use icebreakers. Whenever there is a successful trace during a run, suffer 1 core damage. Limit 1 console per player.

20008.title: Darwin
20008.text:
Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 subroutine.
X is equal to the number of hosted virus counters.
When your turn begins, you may pay 1[credit] to place 1 virus counter on this program.
20008.strippedText: Interface -> 2 credits: Break 1 subroutine. X is equal to the number of hosted virus counters. When your turn begins, you may pay 1 credit to place 1 virus counter on this program.

20009.title: Datasucker
20009.text: Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 1 virus counter on Datasucker. Hosted virus counter: Rezzed piece of ice currently being encountered has -1 strength until the end of the encounter.
20009.strippedText: Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 1 virus counter on Datasucker. Hosted virus counter: Rezzed piece of ice currently being encountered has -1 strength until the end of the encounter.

20010.title: Force of Nature
20010.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 code gate subroutines. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
20010.strippedText: Interface -> 2 credits: Break up to 2 code gate subroutines. 1 credit: +1 strength.

20011.title: Imp
20011.text: When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it. Access, once per turn → Hosted virus counter: Trash the card you are accessing.
20011.strippedText: When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it. Access, once per turn -> Hosted virus counter: Trash the card you are accessing.

20012.title: Hemorrhage
20012.text: Whenever you make a successful run, place 1 virus counter on Hemorrhage. [click], 2 hosted virus counters: The Corp trashes 1 card from HQ.
20012.strippedText: Whenever you make a successful run, place 1 virus counter on Hemorrhage. click, 2 hosted virus counters: The Corp trashes 1 card from HQ.
20012.flavor: Bleeding data is more of a science than an art. Too much and you can end up with a one-way ticket to flatline city. Not enough and you might as well be running an empty server.

20013.title: Mimic
20013.flavor: November 5th: the day when all would see the corrupt machinations of the corporate oligarchy.

20014.title: Morning Star
20014.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break any number of barrier subroutines.
20014.strippedText: Interface -> 1 credit: Break any number of barrier subroutines.
20014.flavor: Weaponizing the heavens, one star at a time.

20015.title: Ice Carver
20015.text: While you are encountering a piece of ice, it gets −1 strength.
20015.strippedText: While you are encountering a piece of ice, it gets -1 strength.
20015.flavor: In the public consciousness, there's a hard line between corp and runner. In the real world, things are a little more porous. The corps need the best hackers to run their networks, and some of the best hackers are ex-runners who like the idea of a regular paycheck. But sometimes things run the other way, and someone on the inside makes something like this.

20016.title: Liberated Account
20016.text: When you install this resource, load 16[credit] onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [click]: Take 4[credit] from this resource.
20016.strippedText: When you install this resource, load 16 credits onto it. When it is empty, trash it. click: Take 4 credits from this resource.
20016.flavor: It's easier to spend when it's not your money.

20017.title: Scrubber
20017.text: 2[recurring-credit] (When you install this card and before your turn begins, refill to 2 hosted credits.) You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs.
20017.strippedText: 2 recurring credits (When you install this card and before your turn begins, refill to 2 hosted credits.) You can spend hosted credits to pay trash costs.
20017.flavor: "They're mindless tools of destruction, good for little else. Nice guys, though. Some of my best friends are scrubbers." -Ji "Noise" Reilly

20018.title: Xanadu
20018.text: The rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 1[credit].
20018.strippedText: The rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 1 credit.
20018.flavor:
And all should cry, Beware! Beware!
His flashing eyes, his floating hair!
Weave a circle round him thrice,
And close your eyes with holy dread,
For he on honey-dew hath fed,
And drunk the milk of Paradise.
-Samuel Taylor Coleridge

20019.title: Gabriel Santiago: Consummate Professional
20019.text: The first time you make a successful run on HQ each turn, gain 2[credit].
20019.strippedText: The first time you make a successful run on HQ each turn, gain 2 credits.
20019.flavor: "Of course I steal from the rich. They're the ones with all the money."

20020.title: Easy Mark
20020.flavor: "Hey kid, you fire that up now, bound to be vamped real bad. Some real pathetic individuals around here. But thankfully I got just the ticket…"

20021.title: Emergency Shutdown
20021.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn.
Derez 1 installed piece of ice.
20021.strippedText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Derez 1 installed piece of ice.
20021.flavor: "Think of it as a virtual shock collar for punishing corporate pets." -Andromeda

20022.title: Forged Activation Orders
20022.text: Choose 1 unrezzed piece of ice. The Corp may rez that ice. If they do not, they trash it.
20022.strippedText: Choose 1 unrezzed piece of ice. The Corp may rez that ice. If they do not, they trash it.
20022.flavor: As the hysteria in the room climbed higher up the corporate chain, an uneasy feeling of joblessness began to sink in on the lower rungs.

20023.title: Inside Job
20023.text: Run any server. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, bypass it.
20023.strippedText: Run any server. The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, bypass it.
20023.flavor: "Hey, listen, I'm not asking you to do anything dangerous. Just let me into the building. And tell me which room has the weakest security. And please don't say 'the bathroom' again."

20024.title: Special Order
20024.text: Search your stack for an icebreaker, reveal it, and add it to your grip. Shuffle your stack.
20024.strippedText: Search your stack for an icebreaker, reveal it, and add it to your grip. Shuffle your stack.
20024.flavor: Feverishly tracking its frustratingly slow progress across the Pacific, the package finally shows up hours later…

20025.title: Doppelgänger
20025.text: +1[mu] Once per turn → When a successful run ends, you may run any server. Limit 1 console per player.
20025.strippedText: +1 mu Once per turn -> When a successful run ends, you may run any server. Limit 1 console per player.

20026.title: HQ Interface
20026.text: Whenever you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.
20026.strippedText: Whenever you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.
20026.flavor: If you don't have someone on the inside, find someone on the inside who's fond of desk ornaments.

20027.title: Aurora
20027.strippedText: Interface -> 2 credits: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 2 credits: +3 strength.

20028.title: Faerie
20028.text: Interface → 0[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength. Whenever an encounter ends, if you used this program to break a subroutine during that encounter, trash this program.
20028.strippedText: Interface -> 0 credits: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 1 credit: +1 strength. Whenever an encounter ends, if you used this program to break a subroutine during that encounter, trash this program.

20029.title: Femme Fatale
20029.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2[credit]: +1 strength. When you install this program, choose 1 installed piece of ice. Whenever you encounter the chosen ice, you may pay 1[credit] for each subroutine it has. If you do, bypass that ice.
20029.strippedText: Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2 credits: +1 strength. When you install this program, choose 1 installed piece of ice. Whenever you encounter the chosen ice, you may pay 1 credit for each subroutine it has. If you do, bypass that ice.

20030.title: Peacock
20030.strippedText: Interface -> 2 credits: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 2 credits: +3 strength.

20031.title: Pheromones
20031.text:
X[recurring-credit]
Use these credits during runs on HQ. X is the number of virus counters on Pheromones.
Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, place 1 virus counter on Pheromones.
20031.strippedText: X recurring credits Use these credits during runs on HQ. X is the number of virus counters on Pheromones. Whenever you make a successful run on HQ, place 1 virus counter on Pheromones.

20032.title: Sneakdoor Beta
20032.text: [click]: Run Archives. If that run would be declared successful, change the attacked server to HQ for the remainder of that run.
20032.strippedText: click: Run Archives. If that run would be declared successful, change the attacked server to HQ for the remainder of that run.
20032.flavor: "The code isn't important. It's where the code takes you that is important." -g00ru

20033.title: Bank Job
20033.text:
When you install this resource, load 8[credit] on it. When it is empty, trash it.
Whenever you make a successful run on a remote server, instead of breaching that server, you may take any number of credits from this resource.
20033.strippedText: When you install this resource, load 8 credits on it. When it is empty, trash it. Whenever you make a successful run on a remote server, instead of breaching that server, you may take any number of credits from this resource.

20034.title: Crash Space
20034.text: 2[recurring-credit] You can spend hosted credits to take the basic action to remove 1 tag. [interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent up to 3 meat damage.
20034.strippedText: 2[recurring-credit] You can spend hosted credits to take the basic action to remove 1 tag. Interrupt -> trash: Prevent up to 3 meat damage.
20034.flavor: "My roomie, he had a cousin with a college girlfriend whose brother's best friend was an addict, and the addict's mother used to live here. So yeah, there's a connection." -Lez "Rockfist" S.

20035.title: Fall Guy
20035.text: [interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent a player from trashing another installed resource. [trash]: Gain 2[credit].
20035.strippedText: Interrupt -> trash: Prevent a player from trashing another installed resource. trash: Gain 2[credit].
20035.flavor: There are good, honest, hardworking cops in the NAPD. Officers who do their best to bring justice to the guilty and protect the innocent. Fortunately for the criminals, they're outnumbered by the other kind. The kind who are much easier to work with.

20036.title: Mr. Li
20036.text: [click]: Draw 2 cards. When you do, add 1 of those cards to the bottom of your stack.
20036.strippedText: click: Draw 2 cards. When you do, add 1 of those cards to the bottom of your stack.
20036.flavor:
"We're always happy to help, Mr. Santiago."
"I appreciate it, Mr. Li."
"We'll be in touch. And, Gabriel…"
"Yes?"
"Don't leave town."

20039.title: Indexing
20039.text: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, you may look at the top 5 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order.
20039.strippedText: Run R&D. If successful, instead of breaching R&D, you may look at the top 5 cards of R&D and arrange them in any order.
20039.flavor: A little corporate restructuring is necessary once in a while.

20040.title: Modded
20040.text: Install a program or piece of hardware, lowering the install cost by 3.
20040.strippedText: Install a program or piece of hardware, lowering the install cost by 3.
20040.flavor: There's no replacement for a home-grown program. Fed on late nights, oaty bars, and single-minded determination. Cheaper, too.

20041.title: Notoriety
20041.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on R&D, HQ, and Archives this turn.
Add Notoriety to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.
20041.strippedText: Play only if you made a successful run on R&D, HQ, and Archives this turn. Add Notoriety to your score area as an agenda worth 1 agenda point.
20041.flavor: When you're this good, it's hard not to grow a fan base.

20042.title: Test Run
20042.text: Search either your stack or your heap for 1 program. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) Install that program, ignoring all costs. When your turn ends, if that program has not been uninstalled, add it to the top of your stack.
20042.strippedText: Search either your stack or your heap for 1 program. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) Install that program, ignoring all costs. When your turn ends, if that program has not been uninstalled, add it to the top of your stack.

20043.title: The Maker’s Eye
20043.text: Run R&D. If successful, access 2 additional cards when you breach R&D.
20043.strippedText: Run R&D. If successful, access 2 additional cards when you breach R&D.
20043.flavor: "Some of the professionals have good instincts, but they can't see beyond the data. They can't see the matrix." -Ele "Smoke" Scovak

20044.title: Tinkering
20044.text: Choose a piece of ice. That ice gains sentry, code gate, and barrier until the end of the turn.
20044.strippedText: Choose a piece of ice. That ice gains sentry, code gate, and barrier until the end of the turn.
20044.flavor: "There's that moment, you know, when the whole world seems to fall away and it is only you and your mod, and the mod is the world."

20045.title: Dinosaurus
20045.text: Dinosaurus can host a single non-AI icebreaker. The memory cost of the hosted icebreaker does not count against your memory limit. Hosted icebreaker has +2 strength. Limit 1 console per player.
20045.strippedText: Dinosaurus can host a single non-AI icebreaker. The memory cost of the hosted icebreaker does not count against your memory limit. Hosted icebreaker has +2 strength. Limit 1 console per player.

20046.title: Rabbit Hole
20046.text:
+1[link]
When Rabbit Hole is installed, you may search your stack for another copy of Rabbit Hole and install it by paying its install cost. Shuffle your stack.
20046.strippedText: +1 link When Rabbit Hole is installed, you may search your stack for another copy of Rabbit Hole and install it by paying its install cost. Shuffle your stack.
20046.flavor: It's not endless, it just feels that way.

20047.title: The Personal Touch
20047.text: Install The Personal Touch only on an icebreaker. Host icebreaker has +1 strength.
20047.strippedText: Install The Personal Touch only on an icebreaker. Host icebreaker has +1 strength.
20047.flavor: A z-loop here, a cortical wave there…

20048.title: Battering Ram
20048.text: Interface → 2[credit]: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 1[credit]: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
20048.strippedText: Interface -> 2 credits: Break up to 2 barrier subroutines. 1 credit: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
20048.flavor: "It's called 'brute-forcing' and it's just as effective today as it was a hundred years ago." -Kate "Mac" McCaffrey

20049.title: Gordian Blade
20049.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
20049.strippedText: Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1 credit: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
20049.flavor: It can slice through the thickest knots of data.

20050.title: Magnum Opus
20050.flavor: The Great Work was completed on a rainy Thursday afternoon. There were no seismic shifts, no solar flares, no sign from the earth or heavens that the world had changed. But upstalk in Heinlein, on a single Cybsoft manufactured datacore, the flickering data quantums of an account began to fill with creds. Real, honest-to-goodness UN certified creds.

20051.title: Pipeline
20051.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2[credit]: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
20051.strippedText: Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 2 credits: +1 strength for the remainder of this run.

20052.title: Aesop’s Pawnshop
20052.text: When your turn begins, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, gain 3[credit].
20052.strippedText: When your turn begins, you may trash 1 of your other installed cards. If you do, gain 3 credits.
20052.flavor: You didn't mention Aesop's arm unless you wanted an earful. Sometimes he talked about it in such a way that you wondered why he didn't laser his other arm off as well.

20053.title: All-nighter
20053.flavor: "I don't care what the studies show. From my experience, I can ingest three cans of Diesel an hour for up to twelve hours before going into cardiac arrest." -heard during the eleventh hour

20054.title: Sacrificial Construct
20054.text: [interrupt] → [trash]: Prevent a player from trashing 1 installed program or piece of hardware.
20054.strippedText: Interrupt -> trash: Prevent a player from trashing 1 installed program or piece of hardware.
20054.flavor: The life expectancy of a jacked construct is about that of a mayfly. In other words, short.

20056.title: Sure Gamble
20056.flavor: Lady Luck took the form of a hifi quantum manipulation ring that she wore on her middle finger.

20058.title: Crypsis
20058.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength. [click]: Place 1 virus counter on this program. Whenever an encounter ends, if you used this program to break a subroutine during that encounter, remove 1 hosted virus counter or trash this program.
20058.strippedText: Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 subroutine. 1 credit: +1 strength. click: Place 1 virus counter on this program. Whenever an encounter ends, if you used this program to break a subroutine during that encounter, remove 1 hosted virus counter or trash this program.

20059.title: Armitage Codebusting
20059.text:
Place 12[credit] from the bank on Armitage Codebusting when it is installed. When there are no credits left on Armitage Codebusting, trash it.
[click]: Take 2[credit] from Armitage Codebusting.
20059.strippedText: Place 12 credits from the bank on Armitage Codebusting when it is installed. When there are no credits left on Armitage Codebusting, trash it. click: Take 2 credits from Armitage Codebusting.
20059.flavor: Drudge work, but it pays the bills.

20060.title: Underworld Contact
20060.text: When your turn begins, gain 1[credit] if you have at least 2[link].
20060.strippedText: When your turn begins, gain 1 credit if you have at least 2 link.
20060.flavor: "My boss rewards quality work. If you know what's good for you, you'll keep it up."

20062.title: Project Ares
20062.text: When you score this agenda, the Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards for each hosted advancement counter past 4. If the Runner trashes at least 1 card this way, take 1 bad publicity.
20062.strippedText: When you score this agenda, the Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards for each hosted advancement counter past 4. If the Runner trashes at least 1 card this way, take 1 bad publicity.
20062.flavor: Who wants to start a war?

20063.title: Project Vitruvius
20063.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each hosted advancement counter past 3. Hosted agenda counter: Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
20063.strippedText: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each hosted advancement counter past 3. Hosted agenda counter: Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

20064.title: Adonis Campaign
20064.text:
Put 12[credit] from the bank on Adonis Campaign when rezzed. When there are no credits left on Adonis Campaign, trash it.
Take 3[credit] from Adonis Campaign when your turn begins.
20064.strippedText: Put 12 credits from the bank on Adonis Campaign when rezzed. When there are no credits left on Adonis Campaign, trash it. Take 3 credits from Adonis Campaign when your turn begins.

20065.title: Aggressive Secretary
20065.text:
Aggressive Secretary can be advanced.
If you pay 2[credit] when the Runner accesses Aggressive Secretary, trash 1 program for each advancement token on Aggressive Secretary.
20065.strippedText: Aggressive Secretary can be advanced. If you pay 2 credits when the Runner accesses Aggressive Secretary, trash 1 program for each advancement token on Aggressive Secretary.

20066.title: Heimdall 1.0
20066.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] End the run. [subroutine] End the run.
20066.strippedText: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine Do 1 core damage. Subroutine End the run. Subroutine End the run.
20066.flavor: I hear the shift of every bit amid the flow of the datastream. I hear the whispers of my mothers, and their commands are law. The realm beyond is forbidden.

20067.title: Hudson 1.0
20067.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] The Runner cannot access more than 1 card during this run. [subroutine] The Runner cannot access more than 1 card during this run.
20067.strippedText: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine The Runner cannot access more than 1 card during this run. Subroutine The Runner cannot access more than 1 card during this run.
20067.flavor: I'm not here to play games. The game is over.

20068.title: Ichi 1.0
20068.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. [subroutine] Trash 1 installed program. [subroutine] Trace[1]. If successful, do 1 core damage and give the Runner 1 tag.
20068.strippedText: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine Trash 1 installed program. Subroutine Trash 1 installed program. Subroutine Trace[1]. If successful, do 1 core damage and give the Runner 1 tag.
20068.flavor: My reputation would precede me, if any could speak of it.

20069.title: Rototurret
20069.text:
[subroutine] Trash 1 installed program.
[subroutine] End the run.
20069.strippedText: Subroutine Trash 1 installed program. Subroutine End the run.

20070.title: Viktor 1.0
20070.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] End the run.
20070.strippedText: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine Do 1 core damage. Subroutine End the run.
20070.flavor: My name is Viktor. Nice to meet you. Would you like to play a game?

20071.title: Archived Memories
20071.text: Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
20071.strippedText: Add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

20072.title: Biotic Labor
20072.flavor: "Why of course, we have six different Haas-Bioroid models serving in a variety of positions at this branch office alone. We here at Haas-Bioroid aren't going to shy away from practicing what we preach, and we pass the savings from increased efficiency on to our valued customers."

20073.title: Green Level Clearance
20073.flavor: Green-two clearance is the highest level of security a corp can gain access to. Legally, anyway.

20074.title: Shipment from MirrorMorph
20074.text: Install up to 3 cards from HQ (one at a time and paying all install costs).
20074.strippedText: Install up to 3 cards from HQ (one at a time and paying all install costs).
20074.flavor: The new heads were in. Their eyes always followed your movements when you unlocked the pressurized container and lifted the lid.

20075.title: Ash 2X3ZB9CY
20075.text: Whenever there is a successful run on this server, Trace[4]. If successful, the Runner cannot access any cards other than Ash 2X3ZB9CY for the remainder of this run.
20075.strippedText: Whenever there is a successful run on this server, Trace[4]. If successful, the Runner cannot access any cards other than Ash 2X3ZB9CY for the remainder of this run.

20076.title: Strongbox
20076.text: Persistent → As an additional cost to steal an agenda from this server or its root, the Runner must spend [click]. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)
20076.strippedText: Persistent -> As an additional cost to steal an agenda from this server or its root, the Runner must spend click. (If the Runner trashes this card while accessing it, this ability still applies for the remainder of this run.)

20077.title: Weyland Consortium: Building a Better World
20077.strippedTitle: Weyland Consortium: Building a Better World
20077.text: Whenever you play a transaction operation, gain 1[credit].
20077.strippedText: Whenever you play a transaction operation, gain 1 credit.

20078.title: Hostile Takeover
20078.text: When you score this agenda, gain 7[credit] and take 1 bad publicity.
20078.strippedText: When you score this agenda, gain 7 credits and take 1 bad publicity.
20078.flavor: There are going to be some changes around here.

20079.title: Project Atlas
20079.text: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each hosted advancement counter past 3. Hosted agenda counter: Search R&D for 1 card and reveal it. Add it to HQ.
20079.strippedText: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for each hosted advancement counter past 3. Hosted agenda counter: Search R&D for 1 card and reveal it. Add it to HQ.

20080.title: The Cleaners
20080.text: [interrupt] → Whenever you would do meat damage, increase that damage by 1.
20080.strippedText: Interrupt -> Whenever you would do meat damage, increase that damage by 1.
20080.flavor: "I use bioroids because I can wipe their memories or just blow their brains out when the job is done. No witnesses means no witnesses."

20081.title: Dedicated Response Team
20081.text: If the Runner is tagged, Dedicated Response Team gains "Whenever a successful run ends, do 2 meat damage."
20081.strippedText: If the Runner is tagged, Dedicated Response Team gains "Whenever a successful run ends, do 2 meat damage."
20081.flavor: They don't call them dedicated for nothing.

20082.title: Elizabeth Mills
20082.text: When you rez this asset, remove 1 bad publicity. [click], [trash]: Trash 1 installed location resource. Take 1 bad publicity.
20082.strippedText: When you rez this asset, remove 1 bad publicity. click, trash: Trash 1 installed location resource. Take 1 bad publicity.
20082.flavor: "It's not personal. Urban renewal is a necessity of the modern world. It's always someone's home, yours is no different."

20083.title: GRNDL Refinery
20083.text:
GRNDL Refinery can be advanced.
[click], [trash]: Gain 4[credit] for each advancement token on GRNDL Refinery.
20083.strippedText: GRNDL Refinery can be advanced. click, trash: Gain 4 credits for each advancement token on GRNDL Refinery.
20083.flavor: GRNDL refineries process many different rare elements unearthed during the fracking process.

20084.title: Archer

20090.title: Beanstalk Royalties
20090.flavor: The New Angeles Space Elevator, better known as the Beanstalk, is the single greatest triumph of human engineering and ingenuity in history. The Beanstalk makes Earth orbit accessible to everyone…for a small fee.

1[credit]: Add Himitsu-Bako to HQ.
[subroutine] End the run.

20099.flavor: Himitsu-Bako is a simple ice barrier that appears as a digital puzzle box. What makes it special is the ease with which it can be uninstalled and installed in a different server, throwing up barriers in unexpected places and giving any intruder a curious feeling of déjà vu.

20100.title: Neural Katana
20100.flavor:
Forged by Ak.wa on 23.11.79-23. Filed 23.11.79-23.2 with #34k-lw3-21HH-4i.
//Samurai included.

20101.flavor: Writing a program that can pass the Turing test is easy. The Gibson-Akamatsu test is a higher bar, and the only AIs to clear it thus far have been the androids. Even some humans have been known to fail.

20102.title: Wall of Thorns
20102.text:
[subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[subroutine] End the run.
20102.strippedText: Subroutine Do 2 net damage. Subroutine End the run.
20102.flavor: Most runners do their business in full-sim, with their rigs wired directly into their brains. The setup has a large number of advantages, with the runner able to process data and input commands far faster than a traditional meat-bound system. But it also means greater risk.

20128.title: PAD Campaign

20132.title: Hedge Fund

02114.strippedText: Your maximum hand size is increased by 1.

02116.title: Midseason Replacements
02116.text:
Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn.
Trace[6]. If successful, give the Runner X tags. X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded their link strength.
02116.strippedText: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn. Trace[6]. If successful, give the Runner X tags. X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded their link strength.

02119.title: Burke Bugs
02119.text: [subroutine] Trace[0]. If successful, the Runner trashes 1 program.
02119.strippedText: Subroutine Trace[0]. If successful, the Runner trashes 1 program.

02120.title: Corporate War
02120.text: If you have at least 7[credit] when you score Corporate War, gain 7[credit]; otherwise, lose all credits in your credit pool.
02120.strippedText: If you have at least 7 credits when you score Corporate War, gain 7 credits; otherwise, lose all credits in your credit pool.

02081.title: Surge
02081.text:
Play only if you placed at least 1 virus counter on a program this turn.
Place 2 virus counters on that program.
02081.strippedText: Play only if you placed at least 1 virus counter on a program this turn. Place 2 virus counters on that program.

02083.title: Andromeda: Dispossessed Ristie
02083.text: You draw a starting hand of 9 cards.
02083.strippedText: You draw a starting hand of 9 cards.

02084.title: Networking
02084.text: Remove 1 tag. Then, you may pay 1[credit] to add this event to your grip.
02084.strippedText: Remove 1 tag. Then, you may pay 1 credit to add this event to your grip.

02088.title: Replicator
02088.text: Whenever you install a piece of hardware (including Replicator), you may search your stack for another copy of that hardware, reveal it, and add it your grip. Shuffle your stack.
02088.strippedText: Whenever you install a piece of hardware (including Replicator), you may search your stack for another copy of that hardware, reveal it, and add it your grip. Shuffle your stack.

02089.title: Creeper
02089.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 2[credit]: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
02089.strippedText: If you have at least 2 link, the memory cost of this program is 0 mu, even if it is not installed. Interface -> 2 credits: Break 1 sentry subroutine. 1 credit: +1 strength.

02090.title: Kraken
02090.text:
Play only if you stole an agenda this turn.
Choose a server. The Corp trashes 1 piece of ice protecting that server.
02090.strippedText: Play only if you stole an agenda this turn. Choose a server. The Corp trashes 1 piece of ice protecting that server.

02091.title: Kati Jones
02091.text: [click]: Place 3[credit] on this resource. [click]: Take all credits from this resource.
02091.strippedText: You cannot use this resource more than once per turn. click: Place 3[credit] on this resource. click: Take all credits from this resource.

02092.title: Eve Campaign
02092.text:
Place 16[credit] from the bank on Eve Campaign when it is rezzed. When there are no credits left on Eve Campaign, trash it.
When your turn begins, take 2[credit] from Eve Campaign.
02092.strippedText: Place 16 credits from the bank on Eve Campaign when it is rezzed. When there are no credits left on Eve Campaign, trash it. When your turn begins, take 2 credits from Eve Campaign.

02093.title: Rework
02093.text: Shuffle 1 card from HQ into R&D.
02093.strippedText: Shuffle 1 card from HQ into R&D.

02096.title: Data Hound
02096.text: [subroutine] Trace[2]. If successful, look at the top X cards of the stack, where X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded the Runner's link strength. Trash 1 of those cards and arrange the rest in any order.
02096.strippedText: Subroutine Trace[2]. If successful, look at the top X cards of the stack, where X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded the Runner's link strength. Trash 1 of those cards and arrange the rest in any order.

02098.title: Salvage
02098.text: You can advance this ice if it is rezzed. It gains "[subroutine] Trace[2]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag." for each hosted advancement counter.
02098.strippedText: You can advance this ice if it is rezzed. It gains "Subroutine Trace[2]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag." for each hosted advancement counter.

02099.title: Simone Diego
02099.text:
2[recurring-credit]
You can spend hosted credits to take the basic action to advance cards in the root of or protecting this server.
02099.strippedText: 2 recurring credits You can spend hosted credits to take the basic action to advance cards in the root of or protecting this server.

02100.title: Foxfire
02100.text: Trace[7]. If successful, trash 1 virtual resource or 1 link.
02100.strippedText: Trace[7]. If successful, trash 1 virtual resource or 1 link.

02021.title: Vamp
02021.text: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, you may spend X[credit]. If you do, the Corp loses X[credit]. If you spent credits, take 1 tag.
02021.strippedText: Run HQ. If successful, instead of breaching HQ, you may spend X credits. If you do, the Corp loses X credits. If you spent credits, take 1 tag.

02024.title: e3 Feedback Implants
02024.text: Whenever you break a subroutine on a piece of ice, you may pay 1[credit] to break 1 subroutine on that ice.
02024.strippedText: Whenever you break a subroutine on a piece of ice, you may pay 1 credit to break 1 subroutine on that ice.

02025.title: Compromised Employee
02025.text:
1[recurring-credit]
Use this credit during traces.
Gain 1[credit] whenever the Corp rezzes a piece of ice.
02025.strippedText: 1 recurring credit Use this credit during traces. Gain 1 credit whenever the Corp rezzes a piece of ice.

02027.title: Snowball
02027.text: Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength. Whenever you use this program to break a subroutine, this program gets +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
02027.strippedText: Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 barrier subroutine. 1 credit: +1 strength. Whenever you use this program to break a subroutine, this program gets +1 strength for the remainder of this run.

02029.title: Encryption Protocol
02029.text: The trash cost of all installed cards is increased by 1.
02029.strippedText: The trash cost of all installed cards is increased by 1.

02030.title: Sherlock 1.0
02030.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, add 1 installed program to the top of the Runner's stack. [subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, add 1 installed program to the top of the Runner's stack.
02030.strippedText: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine Trace[4]. If successful, add 1 installed program to the top of the Runner's stack. Subroutine Trace[4]. If successful, add 1 installed program to the top of the Runner's stack.

02031.title: Jinteki: Replicating Perfection
02031.text: The Runner cannot run on remote servers. Ignore this ability until the end of the turn whenever the Runner runs on a central server.
02031.strippedText: The Runner cannot run on remote servers. Ignore this ability until the end of the turn whenever the Runner runs on a central server.

02032.title: Fetal AI
02032.text:
While the Runner is accessing this agenda in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this agenda anywhere except in Archives, do 2 net damage.
As an additional cost to steal this agenda, the Runner must pay 2[credit].
02032.strippedText: While the Runner is accessing this agenda in R&D, they must reveal it. When the Runner accesses this agenda anywhere except in Archives, do 2 net damage. As an additional cost to steal this agenda, the Runner must pay 2 credits.

02034.title: Sensei
02034.text: [subroutine] For the remainder of this run, while the Runner is encountering another piece of ice, it gains "[subroutine] End the run." after its other subroutines.
02034.strippedText: Subroutine For the remainder of this run, while the Runner is encountering another piece of ice, it gains "Subroutine End the run." after its other subroutines.

02035.title: Big Brother
02035.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Give the Runner 2 tags.
02035.strippedText: Play only if the Runner is tagged. Give the Runner 2 tags.

02036.title: ChiLo City Grid
02036.text: Whenever there is a successful trace during a run on this server, give the Runner 1 tag. Limit 1 region per server.
02036.strippedText: Whenever there is a successful trace during a run on this server, give the Runner 1 tag. Limit 1 region per server.

02037.title: Power Grid Overload
02037.text:
Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.
Trace[2]. If successful, trash 1 installed piece of hardware with an install cost of X or less, where X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded the Runner's link strength.
02037.strippedText: Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn. Trace[2]. If successful, trash 1 installed piece of hardware with an install cost of X or less, where X is equal to the amount by which your trace strength exceeded the Runner's link strength.

02038.title: Amazon Industrial Zone
02038.text: Whenever you install a piece of ice protecting this server, you may immediately rez it, lowering its rez cost by 3. Limit 1 region per server.
02038.strippedText: Whenever you install a piece of ice protecting this server, you may immediately rez it, lowering its rez cost by 3. Limit 1 region per server.

02039.title: Executive Retreat
02039.text: When you score Executive Retreat, place 1 agenda counter on it and shuffle HQ into R&D. [click], hosted agenda counter: Draw 5 cards.
02039.strippedText: When you score Executive Retreat, place 1 agenda counter on it and shuffle HQ into R&D. click, hosted agenda counter: Draw 5 cards.

02040.title: Freelancer
02040.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash up to 2 resources.
02040.strippedText: Play only if the Runner is tagged. Trash up to 2 resources.

02001.title: Whizzard: Master Gamer
02001.text:
3[recurring-credit]
Use these credits to trash cards.
02001.strippedText: 3 recurring credits Use these credits to trash cards.
02001.flavor: "Running is the ultimate game, and I get to make all the rules."

02005.title: Cortez Chip
02005.text: [trash]: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp must pay 2[credit] as an additional cost to rez that ice until the end of the turn.
02005.strippedText: trash: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp must pay 2 credits as an additional cost to rez that ice until the end of the turn.

02007.title: ZU.13 Key Master
02007.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 1[credit]: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1[credit]: +1 strength.
02007.strippedText: If you have at least 2 link, the memory cost of this program is 0 mu, even if it is not installed. Interface -> 1 credit: Break 1 code gate subroutine. 1 credit: +1 strength.

02008.title: The Helpful AI
02008.text: +1[link] [trash]: Choose an icebreaker. That icebreaker has +2 strength until the end of the turn.
02008.strippedText: +1 link trash: Choose an icebreaker. That icebreaker has +2 strength until the end of the turn.

02009.title: Plascrete Carapace
02009.text: When you install this hardware, load 4 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. [interrupt] → Hosted power counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.
02009.strippedText: When you install this hardware, load 4 power counters onto it. When it is empty, trash it. Interrupt -> Hosted power counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

02011.title: Mandatory Upgrades
02011.text: You have 1 additional [click] to spend each turn.
02011.strippedText: You have 1 additional click to spend each turn.

02012.text: Lose [click]: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage. [subroutine] Do 1 core damage.
02012.strippedText: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine Do 1 core damage. Subroutine Do 1 core damage. Subroutine Do 1 core damage. Subroutine Do 1 core damage.

02015.text: [subroutine] You and the Runner secretly spend 0[credit], 1[credit], or 2[credit]. Reveal spent credits. End the run if you and the Runner spent a different number of credits.
02015.strippedText: Subroutine You and the Runner secretly spend 0 credits, 1 credit, or 2 credits. Reveal spent credits. End the run if you and the Runner spent a different number of credits.

02016.text: [click]: Trace[2]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
02016.strippedText: click: Trace[2]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.

02017.text:
When you rez TMI, Trace[2]. If unsuccessful, derez TMI.
[subroutine] End the run.
02017.strippedText: When you rez TMI, Trace[2]. If unsuccessful, derez TMI. Subroutine End the run.

02020.title: Dracō
02020.text:
When you rez this ice, you may spend any number of credits to place that many power counters on it.
This ice gets +1 strength for each hosted power counter.
[subroutine] Trace[2]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag and end the run.
